prompt:
Write the new file studio/workflows/oc-sheet-v3/workflow.toml: the Studio type "OC sheet v3" (task STU-SHEET3D). Start from studio/workflows/oc-sheet/workflow.toml (given as context) and keep everything that is not listed here exactly as it is, including the comments of the params you keep, the [face] table, every [[model]] and the rating and background params.

Changes:
1. The header comments become: "# STU-SHEET3D: OC sheet v3. One wide sheet: full body front, right, left, back, then a head grid of 2 columns x 4 rows" / "# (front, right, left, back; column 1 bare head, column 2 the helmet). Black separator lines reach the model three ways:" / "# an MLSD union control (lines.png), black lines painted on the base picture before the hires pass, and again on the" / "# final picture. Templates from tools/pose-sheet/sheet_v3.py (built from the v2 sheet, no Blender). 1600x640 base, 3600x1440 out." Then a line "# vram_mb PROVISIONAL until measured (v2 peaked at 13.4 GB at 1344x672)."
2. title = "OC sheet v3"; description = "An original character as one wide reference sheet: four full-body views (front, right, left, back) and a grid of head close-ups, with and without a helmet, in cells divided by black lines, so each view can be cut out for a 3D model."
3. [images]: "60" = "pose.png", "64" = "depth.png", "80" = "lines.png", "86" = "helmet.png", "93" = "lines-final.png", with the comment "# STU-SHEET3D: built by tools/pose-sheet/sheet_v3.py; uploaded to ComfyUI before each run (LoadImage node -> file in this folder)."
4. [check]: retries = 3, face_views = ["front", "left", "right"], layout = "oc-v3" with the comment "# STU-SHEET3D: the checker reads the v3 cells (head-* cells need a face except the back one; helmet-* cells are skipped)."
5. [studio]: label = "OC sheet v3", hint = "Four views and head close-ups in a grid", order = 8, px = { wide = [1600, 640] } (sizes stays ["wide"]).
6. Remove the params "helmet", "helmet_desc" and "pair" and their comments (a param named helmet would split the run into a pair in server/src/studio/helmet.rs; v3 is one run).
7. prompt template: "masterpiece, best quality, amazing quality, very aesthetic, absurdres, newest, {rating}, adult, mature, character sheet, character turnaround, reference sheet, multiple views of the same character, full body, front view, side view, from behind, standing, head close-ups, panels divided by black lines, {bg}, {value}"
8. negative template: the same as now without "{helmet_neg}" and without "frame, border, panels, ".
9. face_prompt template: "masterpiece, best quality, amazing quality, very aesthetic, {rating}, adult, mature, detailed face, {value}"
10. A new param after face_prompt, with the comment "# STU-SHEET3D: the helmet column's own prompt (node 85, masked to column 2). Empty: a second bare-head take.":
[[param]]
name = "helmet_look"
type = "string"
default = ""
node = "85"
input = "text"
template = "masterpiece, best quality, amazing quality, very aesthetic, {rating}, adult, mature, head close-up, portrait, helmet, {value}"
11. width: default, min and max 1600; height: default, min and max 640.
Output only the TOML file.

prompt:
Write the new file studio/workflows/weapon-sheet/workflow.toml: the Studio type "Weapon sheet" (task STU-SHEET3D), one weapon drawn from four sides in four cells divided by black lines. Use studio/workflows/oc-sheet/workflow.toml (context) as the model for the layout and the param tables; studio/workflows/weapon-sheet/graph.json (context) is the graph.

Content, in this order:
1. Comments: "# STU-SHEET3D: weapon sheet. One weapon from four sides (front, right side, back, left side) in four cells divided" / "# by black lines (MLSD union control + lines painted before the hires pass and on the final picture). No people, so no" / "# pose or depth control and no face or hand fix. 1344x672 base, 3024x1512 out. vram_mb PROVISIONAL until measured."
2. title = "Weapon sheet"; description = "One weapon as a reference sheet from four sides (front, right, back, left) in cells divided by black lines, ready to cut out for a 3D model."; graph = "graph.json"; outputs = ["20"]; machines = ["soucouyant"]; vram_mb = 10000; ram_mb = 12000.
3. [images] with "80" = "lines.png" and "93" = "lines-final.png" and the comment "# built by tools/pose-sheet/sheet_v3.py weapon".
4. No [check] and no [face] table.
5. [studio]: label = "Weapon sheet", hint = "One weapon from four sides", sizes = ["wide"], order = 9, px = { wide = [1344, 672] }.
6. Params, copied from the OC sheet file where they exist: "prompt" (node "4", input "text", default "an ornate silver longsword with a blue gem in the hilt", template "masterpiece, best quality, amazing quality, very aesthetic, absurdres, newest, {rating}, weapon design sheet, reference sheet, a single weapon shown from four sides, front view, side view, back view, isolated object, no humans, panels divided by black lines, {bg}, {value}"); "negative" (node "5", input "text", template "worst quality, bad quality, low quality, lowres, blurry, jpeg artifacts, watermark, signature, text, logo, person, people, human, hand, holding, character, multiple weapons, different weapons, cropped, {bg_neg}{rating_neg}{value}"); "background" (the same table as the OC sheet, without its STU-R2 comment); "width" (default/min/max 1344, node "6") and "height" (default/min/max 672, node "6"); "seed" (node "7", also = [{ node = "9", input = "seed", add = 1 }] only, comment "# the hires pass uses seed+1"); "rating" (the same table as the OC sheet, with its comment).
7. [[model]] tables for exactly these files, with the licences as written in the OC sheet file: novaAnimeXL_ilV170.safetensors, character_Sheet_XL.safetensors, ILLUST_STYLE_MarvelRivels_ownwaifu.safetensors, xinsir-union-sdxl-promax.safetensors, 4x-AnimeSharp.pth.
Output only the TOML file.
